column1: # Vanilla twins for each light colour in lights.tsv, best first. A shader pack only knows the blocks it names in its
# block.properties, so for a light it doesn't name, mcmetal gives it the id of the first twin the pack does name: the
# pack then lights it the way it lights that vanilla block. Twins named with lit=true (campfire, redstone lamp) or
# without states count; twins a pack only names per facing (SEUS's lit furnaces) don't.
# Small lights (only the bright pixels glow) come first in a chain for small-light colours, so packs that make the
# whole block glow for glowstone-like ids (SEUS PTGI) don't light up a lamp's iron frame. Each chain ends with torch
# or glowstone, which every pack names (SEUS PTGI E12 knows nothing newer than Minecraft 1.14).
